title: The kernel of a surjection of flat modules is flat
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $0\to M'\to M\to M''\to0$ a short exact sequence of $R$-modules. If $M$ and $M''$ are flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $M'$ is flat.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00HM (lemma-flat-ses), second assertion, line 9071
